contains.1.8.85: Design system phase 4, part 4b: the Exp7 demo's Two writers, Storage and Circuit on canvas. Two writers (the collaboration card, the network and sync controls, Alice's and Bob's edits and entries, the merge order, the diff, the path inspector and Show or Hide for each replica's Plan and Board views), Storage (the batch log, the 5000-op test and the per-path statistics) and Circuit (the rule source parsed as you type, the rules, the event arguments, what fired, the canonical print and the scores) are Exp7VM models drawn by Exp7DemoUI. Checkboxes are toggle buttons, menus are chips, folding sections are Show and Hide buttons, and tables merge columns to fit a phone. The collaboration engine's refusals are recorded in Exp7Fail. A multiline field grows to the lines its text wraps to, and another tab opens at its top. Removed: the lean's Doc and Panel helper script (Exp7Experiments), the collaboration DOM script, renderSync, renderLog, renderScores, renderSyncDiff, renderPathStats, renderInspector, the three DOM sections and their styles. Budget unchanged.
contains.1.8.84: Design system phase 4, part 4a: the Exp7 demo on canvas. Its frame (title, codec chip, Copy diagnostics, the ten tabs and the diagnostics box), the Atlas, the Proposal console, About and the path inspectors are Exp7VM models drawn by JRViews with the platform's view tokens and the exp7-views art, through a new Exp7DemoUI in the demo; a tap runs the control's act through its screen's handler, and text fields are JRender TextFields. Exp7VM can now draw text runs, code text, multiline and filling fields, notes in ok, bad and warn tones, warn chips, button cells and toned rows in tables, and tappable panels; the views use none of it, so Budget and the views draw the same. New tokens: warn and the note and row tones; new art variants in exp7-views and budget-journal. A screen with a character the fonts lack fails with GLYPH_MISSING instead of drawing a box. A screen that can't be laid out keeps its last frame and records the failure; the demo reports ready only once its screens have drawn. Removed: the demo's Budget mode (unreached since Budget has its own slot: its atlas, IndexedDB store, modes, type bar, rank panel, examples and window.exp7 entries), the codec's optional path and estimates, bootStep and the try and catch around renders and diagnostics, the clipboard's execCommand fallback, renderBatch, renderAtlas, and the HTML header and tab bar. Listed changes: everything that moved is drawn on canvas (body font for code, steppers for sliders, YYYY-MM-DD fields for dates, chips for the op menu, one column, 620 px inner scroll, tabs no longer sticky, Prefer and Unavailable buttons for the star and no-entry symbols, and words for other characters the drawing fonts lack, Best and unavailable chips, diagnostics in a canvas note). Two writers, Storage and Circuit are part 4b; Paths and the views' side panels part 4c. Tests in exp7-jrender tests/layer4-demo.mjs.
contains.1.8.83: Design system phase 4, part 3: the journal's plan, monthly expenses and cash views on components, tokens and art. A journal node in a view model is laid out by Exp7Journal.viewLayout from new components (ViewHead, DateBand, Label, MoneyRow, TotalRow) plus Note and Row, in the views.journal:budget failure context; its rules, month band and Home's keyboard focus ring (FocusFrame) are five more budget-journal pieces drawn in SVG with the studies, and its sizes are 26 more Budget tokens. Home draws the focus ring before anything is shown and keeps the last frame (and the old focus) when it can't. A journal kind with no layout (calendar, agenda: not reached from the app) and a cash row with no amount now fail. Removed: journal-views' colour, type and spacing tables, hand-drawn chevrons and marks, the old hand-placed layout, Exp7Journal.type, space, colors and glyphs, and Home's plan picker and date menus, which nothing could open. Same as 1.8.82 to 1/64 px, which moves glyph-edge antialiasing only (0 px in Chrome with 1.8.82 rounded the same way), except: names and notes that were cut off at the edge now wrap, the ledger's covered heading text is gone, and a view's navigation tap area is the view's height. Tests in exp7-jrender tests/layer4-journal.mjs.
contains.1.8.82: Design system phase 4, part 2: the platform's top bar and Apps picker on components, tokens and art. New shared script design-chrome registers TopBar, ChromeButton, Avatar, AppsPanel and AppCard, and Exp7Chrome.layout lays out a bar or a picker from a model in its own failure context. Every face, bevel, ring and shadow comes from a new art pack, exp7-chrome (6 pieces, drawn in SVG with the studies), and the sizes from a chrome token set (Exp7Tokens.chrome). PlatformChromeJR builds models instead of HTML; its local paint, default apps list, default avatar box, width stand-ins, photo fallbacks and try and catch blocks are gone. A bar or picker that can't be laid out keeps its last frame and records the failure. Nothing changes on screen, except that a selected app card goes back to its own gold when the pointer leaves it. The picker now redraws when the window is resized.
contains.1.8.81: Design system phase 4, part 1: the Calendar, Board and Plan views on components, tokens and art. New shared script design-views registers the view components (Panel, Button, Chip, InputBox, DayCell, DayStep, TableRow, and for Budget DateChevron and FocusRing). The views draw every face, shadow, tint, outline and rule from art: a new exp7-views pack for the platform look and twelve view pieces added to budget-journal for Budget's. Views take a view token set; the stock and journal skins, the default view tokens, the field style default and the views' error page are gone, and a view that can't be laid out keeps its last frame. The renderer is the JRender build from exp7-jrender #8 (GPU group transforms, wrap baselines), unused so far. Nothing changes on screen: the views lay out byte for byte as in 1.8.80. TopBar and the Apps picker are part 2.
contains.1.8.80: Design system phase 3: art slots live. New shared script design-art: an app's look is its art pack, checked when it loads (every slot of every component, in every variant and state, inside its box, text over it readable), and art can be swapped for the app, one screen or one item; a swap that fails keeps the art there was. Budget's first pack (budget-journal, 43 pieces) draws today's look: it is drawn in SVG with the studies, compiled in exp7-jrender and embedded here. Every Budget component now places art in its slots instead of drawing in code (chevrons, rules, day cells and their tints, marks, field boxes, radio, check box and star, toggles, the mint band, time cells, the selected hour), and hover comes from each piece's own hover drawing. The glyph and mark drawing code and 19 tokens only it used are gone. Nothing changes on screen: the draw lists are byte for byte those of 1.8.79.
contains.1.8.79: Design system phase 2. Every Budget screen besides Home is now laid out from design components inside a failure context: the day schedule, a day item, add an item, the pay, debt, activity and cash forms (with the Field, Choice, Every, Toggle, Pair, PrimaryBand, TimePicker, FieldDatePicker and BackBar components), edit and record, alternatives, the category, requirements, the switch review (BeforeAfter), monthly expenses, and cash and owned items. Every action runs in a failure context: if the screen it leads to cannot be laid out, nothing changes and the last screen stays. The fixed-coordinate painter (paintScreen and flowShift), the per-screen layout code and the static study screens are gone; a route with no screen fails with DATA_MISSING instead of showing a sample. Alternatives opened from a day item with none yet now show that item instead of the first plan step.
contains.1.8.78: A fuller journal font. Source Sans 3 Regular and Semibold now have every Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A letter, plus what the font has of Latin Extended-B, Latin Extended Additional, punctuation and currency signs: 687 characters each, was 120. A name such as "Café" or "Łódź" now draws on Budget Home; before, it stopped Home with GLYPH_MISSING. The 120 old glyphs are kept byte for byte and the font metrics are unchanged, so text without accents lays out exactly as in 1.8.77. The font licence (SIL Open Font License 1.1) is embedded with the fonts. Greek, Cyrillic, separate combining accents and emoji are still not in the font.
contains.1.8.77: Design system phase 1. New shared scripts: design-fail (failable steps and failure contexts that roll back), design-tokens (Budget's complete token set, checked as a whole), design-bounds (bounds, the readable rect table, text measured and shrunk to fit by JRender only) and design-components. Budget Home is laid out by components inside a failure context, with the same layout as 1.8.76: a few headings and labels sit 0.4 to 2.3 px higher because text is now placed from the font's own metrics, and a long entry name wraps instead of ending in an ellipsis. The text width estimate and the substitute journal font are gone.
contains.1.8.76: Budget data has a Clear data button for a fresh start (account menu, Budget data). It asks first and names what goes: the budget on this device and, with GitHub connected, the sealed copy in the data repo. Other Exp7 apps are not touched, and this device keeps its sync key. The repo copy is deleted first; if that fails nothing is cleared. The Budget data box now shows when signed out too, where Clear data clears this device only.
contains.1.8.75: Fix: Accept on the plan switch review now switches the plan. Before, it only started a proposal and still said "Plan updated". The requirement answers are saved with the switch: Reuse a copy makes a separate copy for the new choice, starting when it does; Not needed and Needs its own are recorded; requirements added for the new choice are added. The plan changes only when the save is accepted, and says so; otherwise the current plan stays. Answers belong to one step and one choice, so the next alternative's review starts unanswered. The requirement status (Not decided, Needs its own...) now shows on the right instead of off screen, and the review says "Carried over from the choice in use." After a switch, the next alternative is reviewed against the requirements of the choice now in use: a Reuse copy in place of the original, Not needed left out, Needs its own kept, and those made for that choice added. A copy of a copy keeps the original name.
contains.1.8.74: Budget on a phone (section 1). The journal fills a 390 pt phone screen with no side margin; the Home mini month has a plain-words legend and the selected day's reason wraps; the month picker opens inline under the heading with drawn arrows and pushes the rows down, and the full-page month view is gone. The schedule page has a Home back row, an Add row and an All day section. Fields keep what was typed when you tap the next field, and the time grid opens on the same tap. Forms show empty values instead of blanks, and labels move with notes that wrap. Adding an alternative names the real item, the star decides preferred, the new alternative is charged like the item it replaces, and a new requirement starts empty. The switch review shows the person's own plan with Before and After stacked. Debt calculated rows are no longer tap targets. A long step or requirement name wraps and pushes the choices under it down instead of overlapping them.
contains.1.8.73: Fix: Home scrolls again after opening a plan step and going back. Returning to the plan step was re-applied on every scroll, so Home snapped back to it; it now runs once and ends at the first wheel, touch, pointer or key input, or after a moment.
contains.1.8.72: Fix: Budget Home no longer stops with "seeded.map is not a function" when opening Requirements for a new alternative. An item's jreq is a single reference, not a list; the requirement list is now seeded from a reference, a list, a group or a record, and a reference shows the named item.
contains.1.8.71: Calendar-first and data-repo fixes. The data repo is created private by itself once GitHub access works (no create button, never from a half-typed repo name, never overwritten) and every failure says what GitHub reports while local saving continues. Items with no date open their edit page with the date picker so they can be dated, and join the calendar once dated; Change applies to this occurrence or this and future without rewriting earlier ones; Record what happened is saved to the occurrence (this occurrence only unless chosen otherwise, with the item and its planned amount shown); a day row shows that day's recorded or changed amount; Specific dates each month repeats on those days, and the days box shows what will be saved (the date's day until changed); day rows say how an item repeats in words; a tap on Save or a row while a field is still open now lands on the first tap; tapping a calendar entry opens that item's own page (name, day, time, repeat, amount) instead of the sample item; the date and tab refresh keeps the tapped entry and a form's draft; real schedules no longer say their values are sample data; an amount entered on the calendar is the cost each time (not split across the month's dates); pay on the calendar is the take-home. Old Board asset, debt and pay entries open the selected calendar day; Budget has no what-if path; cash is never inferred from a name.
contains.1.8.70: Home has one way to open a day's schedule (second tap on the selected mini-month day). Activity date pickers expand inline; Repeat subrows reflow; times are 24-hour; Amount has one label. Plan lives only on Home, with wrapped step text and a back stack to the step. New alternatives and new requirements share date/time/repeat fields.
contains.1.8.69: Day and Plan entry; form overlays sit on the drawn box, including a Safari width correction; date, time, and debt as-of are real pickers; Repeat, deductions, and debt fields persist onto the agenda calendar; all-day pay, debt, and cash rows appear on the day schedule; Save debt opens the as-of day.
contains.app: 1.8.68: Budget journal back controls use a drawn chevron plus Home/Plan text (the platform bar no longer uses a Unicode arrow that became tofu); long row names and selected items never overlap (two-line or ellipsis); Add to <day> is visible on the selected calendar day and opens the four-kind chooser; a Plan row opens the alternatives list with + Add an alternative, then category, preferred star, requirements review, and Plan switch Before/After Accept; monthly expenses lists Income/Expenses dated through today and Scheduled this month without a 40-row cap, with the month total after the last row and a scrollable sticky-canvas page; Cash and owned item rows open the as-of calendar day and no longer share a full-page Home hit; CSS pt equals design pt (host size from CSS, not device pixels).
contains.chromeJr: PlatformChromeJR: bar and Apps picker as Exp7Chrome models (design-chrome components, exp7-chrome art, chrome tokens; 1.8.82); JRDI circular avatar photo, initials when there is no photo or it cannot load; Budget tabs in hostDoc
